newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: MACINTOSH SEEKS STAKE IN SHOE RETAILER.
newsitem.headline: MACINTOSH SEEKS STAKE IN SHOE RETAILER.

text.p: Retail group Macintosh NV said on Friday it was holding talks about acquiring a 50 percent stake in shoe and sporting goods retailer Hoogenbosch Retail Group with an option to extend this later to 100 percent.
Macintosh said if the deal went ahead as expected, Hoogenbosch was expected to make a "good contribution" to Macintosh's earnings per share.
Hoogenbosch has annual sales of some 350 million guilders and operates 211 stores in the Netherlands, seven in Belgium and 12 in Germany.
Its chains include the Dolcis and Manfield shoe stores and the Olympus sporting goods stores.
Macintosh said the Hoogenbosch chains had a good level of profitability, its stores were located in prime locations and were either market leader or among the leaders in their sector.
